title: ULME: Predictive Coupling for Mutually Reinforcing Embedding and Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.30705v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text embedding and text generation are two of the most useful capabilities of modern large language models, yet they are typically provided by separate specialized models (an embedder and a generator) trained with incompatible objectives and deployed side by side in retrieval-augmented generation and agent systems. Recent unified embedding-generation models such as GritLM share parameters between the two capabilities, but they either switch attention regimes between modes or optimize embedding and language modeling as parallel objectives that never supervise each other. We argue that these designs are only partially unified: the two capabilities coexist on the same weights, but do not shape each other. We propose ULME, a post-training framework that unifies embedding and language modeling on a causal decoder-only LLM through predictive coupling. translated_title: ULME：通过预测性耦合实现嵌入与语言建模的相互增强
translated_abstract: 文本嵌入和文本生成是现代大语言模型最有用的两种能力，然而它们通常由单独的专门模型分别提供（嵌入器和生成器），这些模型使用不兼容的目标进行训练，并在检索增强生成和智能体系统中并行部署。近期出现的统一嵌入-生成模型（如GritLM）在两种能力之间共享参数，但它们要么在不同模式之间切换注意力机制，要么将嵌入和语言建模作为从未相互监督的并行目标进行优化。我们认为这些设计只是部分统一：两种能力虽然共存于相同的权重之上，但并未相互塑造。我们提出了ULME，这是一个后训练框架，通过预测性耦合在因果解码器架构的大语言模型上统一嵌入和语言建模。ULME在查询和答案之间插入一串可学习的槽位，读取语义嵌入信息，使两种能力能够相互增强。
tldr: ULME提出了一种后训练框架，通过预测性耦合机制让文本嵌入与语言建模两种能力在同一因果解码器大语言模型上真正统一并相互增强，突破了以往统一模型中两种目标互不监督的局限。
en_tdlr: ULME is a post-training framework that achieves true unification of text embedding and language modeling on a causal decoder-only LLM through predictive coupling, enabling the two capabilities to mutually reinforce each other rather than merely coexist as parallel objectives.
